description: 'Harbor Mechanical' without 'Co' on Summit; duct rework

email.subject: Summit - BC-5005 duct rework L3
email.body:
Hi,

Harbor Mechanical's duct run above the L3 corridor at Summit was hung below the coordinated elevation and clashed with the ceiling grid. It had to be dropped and rehung.

BC-5005: duct rework, L3 corridor, $1,875.50.

Thanks,
Dana Ortiz
Project Manager, Apex Builders
